title: Highly recommended
text:
We were with my 7-year-old son a few days ago. I don't know if because of the current situation, but there were very few people on board, which made the crossing very pleasant and safe.
The experience was very pleasant, the staff is very friendly and attentive. 
The journey took about an hour and during the "trip" the staff makes a mini game for the children, who receive a pirate gift:-)
The views from the boat are very nice and the walk is very pleasant.
From my point of view, a recommended activity.
author: jessi_mk02

title: Great tour with Barcelona Litoral
text: We enjoyed the tour very much. Nice and calm trip, no annoying load disco music, and no tpouristic babbling all the time, just a nice and relaxing boat trip on a nice old (modified) sailing boat.
